map.准时且合格为什么重要？: Why does on-time and qualified matter?
map.准时率和良品率单独看都可能偏高，但只有「既准时又合格」的批次才真正满足交付要求；: On-time rate and good-rate may both look high individually, but only batches that are 'both on-time and qualified' truly meet delivery requirements; joint pass rate = on-time-and-qualified ÷ total batches, the strictest measure of delivery quality.
map.四类计数怎么填？: How to fill the four count types?
map.总批次是分母；准时批次指按约定交期送达的批次数；合格批次指到货检验无次品的批次数: Total batches is the denominator; on-time batches are those delivered by the agreed date; qualified batches are those with no defects on arrival inspection; on-time-and-qualified must satisfy both (intersection) and cannot be simply added.
